title: App cannot connect to the database
briefing: The application deployed successfully, but users receive database errors when loading the dashboard.

artifacts.logs: django.db.utils.OperationalError: could not connect to server: Connection timed out

options.text: Verify the database hostname, network access, and database availability

options.why_wrong: More application workers do not fix an unreachable database.
Hiding errors does not restore the database connection.

options.text: Increase the static files cache duration
options.why_wrong: Static file caching is unrelated to database connectivity.

explanation: The application cannot establish a connection to the configured database host. The hostname may be outdated, the database may be unavailable, or network rules may block the connection.
lesson: Check the database endpoint, port, service availability, and network access before changing application worker settings. Never expose database credentials in logs.
hints: The deployment completed, but database requests are timing out.
Check the configured database hostname and port.
Verify database availability and network access from the application environment.
